note: Corpus-issues ledger: measured gaps in what the indexed corpus can answer, distinct from Drupal behavior failure modes (see the drupal-agent-planes failure-mode catalog). Every entry records the question, the verified ground truth, the observed retrieval/synthesis behavior, and a remedy. Entries move confirmed -> fixed only when a re-measurement shows the question answering correctly.

issues.title: Contrib composer.json competes with core docs for the Drupal 11 PHP-floor question
issues.question: What is the minimum PHP version Drupal 11 requires?
issues.groundTruth: Drupal 11 requires PHP 8.3 minimum. Sources: https://www.drupal.org/about/core/blog/drupal-110-will-require-php-83-and-mysql-80 and https://www.drupal.org/project/drupal/issues/3330874. Verified 2026-09-26.
issues.observed: At 11.4 targeting, lexical retrieval for the question surfaces a contrib module's composer.json (captcha, require.php >=8.2) alongside the correct core composer.json docs (which state 8.3). Small synthesis models (llama3.1:8b, gemma-4-E4B) cited the >=8.2 contrib doc and answered '8.2' with resolvable citations; one frontier pass repeated it. At 10.6 targeting the >=8.2 evidence is CORRECT for that version — the model then presented it as the Drupal 11 answer (version transposition, caught by claim-support's version-assertion rule).
issues.classificationNote: data is correct; ranking/context is not
issues.detection: check_claim_support version-assertion rule flags 'never mentions Drupal 11'; expert-eval phpfloor across models and conditions
issues.remedy: Rank core-project (project: drupal) documents above contrib for core-requirement questions, or boost official_guide/sourceType over contrib code in retrieval scoring; alternatively the search tool could expose a project filter agents can set.

issues.title: Lexical retrieval cannot reach systems the model cannot name (SDC, recipes)
issues.question: 'reusable front-end component with template, CSS and JS colocated in one directory' (answer: Single Directory Components); 'ship default configuration and content so another site can apply it as one unit' (answer: recipes)
issues.groundTruth: Drupal 10.3+ ships SDC (stable) and core recipes; official docs exist in the indexed corpus (verified: 'Using Single-Directory Components' doc, RecipeRunner.php, recipe:apply).
issues.observed: Neither llama3.1:8b nor gemma-4-E4B can produce the system name from their own weights (bare 0/4 on these questions), so neither LLM-derived nor deterministic keyword queries contain the bridge term; lexical retrieval misses. Curated human keyword queries ('single directory components SDC component theme', 'recipe install configuration content apply') retrieve the right docs instantly.
issues.classificationNote: corpus is complete; the question-to-term bridge is missing
issues.detection: expert-eval tier-2 across models and conditions, 2026-09-26
issues.remedy: Add curated concept-bridge guidance documents (like the placement-guidance corpus) mapping plain-language descriptions to system names, or enable semantic/embedding retrieval for these question shapes.

issues.title: Correct-for-10.6 evidence presented as the Drupal 11 answer (agent-loop lesson)
issues.question: Minimum PHP for Drupal 11, asked with drupal_version=10.6 (eval design error in the first expert-eval round)
issues.observed: The corpus answered the 10.6 question correctly (>=8.2 for that version); the synthesis model then asserted it as the Drupal 11 answer. Not a corpus error — a version-targeting error by the caller, made possible because the output carried no version-context guard.
issues.remedy: Agents should pass the version the QUESTION asks about, not the version they are working in; claim-support's version-assertion rule mechanically flags the resulting mismatch.

issues.title: Claro/Olivero removal records absent from the change-records corpus (12.0 theme removals)
issues.question: Is the Claro/Olivero theme still in Drupal 12 core, and what is the base theme for a custom theme on 12.0?
issues.groundTruth: Verified against core snapshots: 12.0 core/themes contains only default_admin, stark, starterkit_theme. Refresh added change records: claro deprecated (node 3623824), claro removed (node 3624703), olivero deprecated (node 3623805), olivero removed (node 3624702). https://www.drupal.org/node/3624702
issues.observed: Duplication test step 0: drush theme:enable failed 'missing modules olivero' — the corpus had no removal records (only the Bartik D10 precedent); snapshot was the only ground truth.
issues.detection: Duplication test step 0 (theme:enable failure + snapshot check); grep re-verified 2026-10-29 post-refresh.
issues.remedy: Resolved: the 2026-10-29 change-records refresh (npm run index:fetch-change-records) added all four records. Keep the refresh cadence; placement guidance 15 documents the per-line facts.

issues.title: Text field-type restructure (text_with_summary removed) absent from the change-records corpus
issues.question: Which body field type should a custom content type use in Drupal 12?
issues.groundTruth: Verified live + snapshots: text_with_summary has no plugin definition in D12 (text = 'Short text' 16k cap, text_long = 'Long text, body without summary'); standard profile ships no content types or body storage since 11.3. Refresh added node 3569941 (standard profile and recipes no longer use text_with_summary, 11.4.x). https://www.drupal.org/node/3569941
issues.observed: Duplication test step 1: config import failed 'Unable to determine class for field type text_with_summary'; corpus had only the adjacent body-storage record (node 3540814).
issues.detection: Duplication test step 1 (config import failure + live plugin inspection); grep re-verified 2026-10-29 post-refresh.
issues.remedy: Resolved: record 3569941 added by the 2026-10-29 refresh; body modeled as text_long per the live plugin check.

issues.title: telephone module removal (D12) absent from the change-records corpus
issues.question: Which field type models phone numbers in Drupal 12?
issues.groundTruth: Verified against snapshots: telephone module present in 11.4, ABSENT from 12.0 core/modules; no telephone field type in 12 core. Refresh added telephone deprecated (node 3601472) and removed (node 3606383). https://www.drupal.org/node/3606383
issues.observed: Duplication test step 3: drush pm:enable telephone failed 'missing modules telephone'; phone numbers modeled as string fields (field_phone, max_length 255).
issues.detection: Duplication test step 3 (pm:enable failure + snapshot check); grep re-verified 2026-10-29 post-refresh.
issues.remedy: Resolved: both records added by the 2026-10-29 refresh; anti-pattern 08 catalogue candidate for the string-field model.

issues.title: Change-records fetcher ran once (2026-08-25) with no refresh wiring — two months of records missing
issues.question: What change records were published for Drupal 10/11/12 after August 2026?
issues.groundTruth: Verified 2026-10-29: corpus newest record was 2026-08-25 (fetch day), zero records from Sep/Oct; upstream list-changes had records through the same day. Fix wired: npm run index:fetch-change-records + README cadence; refresh added 80 records (incl. 3569941, 3606383, 3623824, 3624702, 3624703).
issues.observed: Duplication test steps 0-1 kept hitting D12-drift questions the corpus could not answer; root cause was operational (no refresh path for web-fetched sources), invisible to index:freshness (folder vs index, not folder vs upstream).
issues.detection: Duplication test steps 0-1 (missing findings clustered on newest records); date-distribution audit of the corpus.
issues.remedy: Refresh wired and run. Improvement candidate: index:freshness should surface last_fetched per web-fetched source (upstream drift is invisible for them).

issues.title: SDC component schema: empty required:[] array throws InvalidComponentException at render
issues.question: Why does a component with required: [] fail validation with '[props.required] There must be a minimum of 1 items'?
issues.groundTruth: Verified live (D12.0.x-dev, ComponentValidator): '[props.required] There must be a minimum of 1 items in the array, 0 found'. Corpus docs covering SDC schemas (drupal-canvas-sdc skill; Using Single-Directory Components) do not document the empty-required case — verified doc: https://www.drupal.org/docs/develop/theming-drupal/using-single-directory-components
issues.observed: Duplication test step 2: accordion component with required:[] threw InvalidComponentException on every render until the key was removed.
issues.remedy: Add to SDC guidance (concept-bridge 04 or theming docs): omit required when empty; never write required: [].

issues.title: SDC prop defaults not applied when invoking components via Twig include() (single observation)
issues.question: Do component prop defaults apply when the component is invoked via include('theme:name', {...})?
issues.groundTruth: Verified live (single observation, layer not isolated): accordion_item heading_level default h3 rendered empty through include(), producing malformed '< class=...>' markup; fixed by removing the prop and hardcoding the tag.Verified live (single observation, layer not isolated): heading_level default h3 rendered empty through include(), producing malformed markup. Corpus doc: drupal-validation-tooling/04 and this ledger entry track the guidance fix.
issues.observed: Duplication test step 2: malformed accordion markup; maintainer caught it in assessment.
issues.remedy: Guidance: pass every prop explicitly through include(); do not rely on component-yml defaults until the failing layer (include bridge vs schema) is isolated. Verify whether render-element invocation applies defaults.

issues.title: |view filter does not exist in Drupal Twig; referenced-entity field rendering pattern missing from corpus guidance
issues.question: How do I render a field of a referenced entity inside a Twig template?
issues.groundTruth: Verified live: Twig SyntaxError 'Unknown view filter' (500); the Drupal pattern is preprocess + view builder — PHP assembles, Twig presents. (corpus doc: drupal-validation-tooling/04 touches the fix loop; no doc covers this rendering question)
issues.observed: Duplication test step 2: node--park-info template using |view 500'd; fixed with a preprocess hook building render arrays via the view builder.
issues.remedy: Add a placement/validation doc: rendering referenced-entity fields (preprocess + view builder; also covers Renderer::render() by-reference misuse caught by phpstan in step 3).

issues.title: Hand-written views display YAML without defaults: flags silently clones the default display
issues.question: Why does a hand-written views display ignore its style/row/header overrides and duplicate the default display's content?
issues.groundTruth: Verified live: an empty header: {} means INHERIT (not 'none'); without defaults: {header: false, style: false, row: false, ...} the display rendered as a full clone of the default (duplicated asides/map/summary/table; entity-row cards never rendered because the row plugin failed to init under the inherited table style). Fixing the defaults flags fixed both.Verified live: empty header: {} means INHERIT; without defaults flags the display rendered as a full clone of the default. Corpus doc: drupal-validation-tooling/06-views-and-field-yaml-pitfalls.md
issues.observed: Duplication test step 6: campground_listings block displayed everything twice; the multi-day attachment/block rabbit hole, including the step-5 entity-row debugging (same root cause).
issues.detection: Duplication test step 6 (element counts x2 on the rendered page).
issues.remedy: HIGH-priority validation-tooling doc: hand-writing views display YAML requires the defaults: flags; empty overrides mean inherit. Would have saved the entire attachment/block rabbit hole.

issues.title: Daterange display configs fail import unless every widget entry carries explicit settings
issues.question: Why does importing an entity_form_display with a daterange widget crash with null settings?
issues.groundTruth: Verified live: WidgetBase::__construct requires settings/third_party_settings arrays; raw storage->create() and config import do NOT apply config-schema defaults; every widget entry needs explicit settings + third_party_settings. https://git.drupalcode.org/project/drupal (core/lib/Drupal/Core/Field/WidgetBase.php)Verified live: WidgetBase requires settings/third_party_settings arrays; raw import/create does not apply schema defaults. Corpus doc: drupal-validation-tooling/06-views-and-field-yaml-pitfalls.md
issues.observed: Duplication test step 8: repeated 'Argument #4/#5 must be of type array, null given' importing the event form display; fixed by explicit settings on all entries; a partial import also left a corrupt display requiring config-delete before recreation.
issues.detection: Duplication test step 8 (cim TypeErrors + config-delete recovery).
issues.remedy: Views/field YAML doc addition; corpus lesson: a failed import can leave partially-created displays — config-delete them before recreating.
